entities.summary: Jemal Karchkhadze was a Georgian writer. He is the author of six novels, some short stories and essays. His works are conceptual and gained popularity after his death. His novel Antonio and David was published in Swedish in 2013, in Arabic in 2014 and in English in 2015.
